name: tracker
description: The life cycle of audit findings in GitHub issues: open the missing issues from scanner runs or any findings file (deduplicated by a key written into each issue), sync them with later scans (close what was resolved, reopen what came back), triage open issues against the current code with a skeptic counter-check, and fix them in batches — one branch, one worktree and one draft pull request per batch.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin: en (English), fr (Français), es (Español), de (Deutsch).

triager_model.title: Model — triager
triager_model.description: Model of the triager agents: inherit (the session's model), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable. Default: sonnet.

triager_effort.title: Effort — triager
triager_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the triager agents: inherit (the session's effort), low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default: medium.
